about.title: About Roma Fiorita
about.p1: Roma Fiorita is a flower and gift shop in the heart of Rome. We hand-tie every bouquet in our workshop and deliver across Italy.
about.p2: Our promise is trust: we send a photo of your real bouquet before it leaves the shop, our prices are all-in with no hidden fees, and we deliver on time.
about.p3: In Rome our own riders deliver the same day; across the rest of Italy we send next-day by courier.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: We're here to help with orders and deliveries.

legal.reviewNote: This is placeholder text and must be reviewed by a qualified professional before launch.

terms.title: Terms of sale
terms.p1: Prices are shown all-in in EUR and include everything stated on the product page.
terms.p2: Fresh flowers are perishable goods and are excluded from the 14-day right of withdrawal under Italian and EU consumer law.
terms.p3: Where a specific stem is unavailable, we may substitute it with one of equal or greater value and comparable style.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: We process your data to fulfil orders and deliveries. Processors include our hosting, email and image providers.
privacy.p2: Non-essential cookies, including analytics, run only after you give consent in the cookie banner.
privacy.p3: You may request access to or deletion of your personal data at any time.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.p1: Essential cookies keep your session and cart working and do not require consent.
cookies.p2: Analytics cookies are loaded only after you accept them, and you can change your choice at any time.
cookies.p3: See the privacy policy for how we handle the data these cookies collect.
